acceptanceCriteria: The LCP-V0 citations into types.go and lifecycle.go are pinned to a commit or replaced by identifier-based references accepted by line-citations-check.
make line-citations-check passes before and after a test insertion of one line in lifecycle.go.
No change to the LCP-V0 requirement text.
body: Observed 2026-10-13 on lane V1-1303 (PR beamfall/corvint#856). docs/specs/local-completion-policy-v0.md cites internal/localcompletion/types.go line 157 and lifecycle.go lines 456 to 607 without a pinned commit, and line-citations-check verifies them against the working tree. Adding the sidecar-reuse code forced line-neutral edits: a wrapper was moved to the new sidecar_reuse.go and two regexp vars were merged only to keep those files' line counts. Expected: citations are pinned to a commit (the form the line-citations contract already admits for other specs) or point at identifiers rather than line ranges, so ordinary edits to those files do not require layout preservation. Actual: any line-count change in those two files fails the doc gate.
title: local-completion-policy-v0 line citations into types.go and lifecycle.go are unpinned and freeze the source layout
